sprint: Sprint 7 — v0.3 Corpus Application and Standardization-Readiness Gate

agency_segments.boundary_description: The authorized firing sequence from preparation through scored release.
agency_segments.allowed_assistance: Regulated firearm, sights, clothing, and event controls.
agency_segments.causal_attribution: Athlete stability, timing, and fine-motor execution are causally necessary.
agency_segments.uncertainty: No material phase ambiguity remains at this level of analysis.

distributed_arena_relation.physical_site_relation: Athletes compete at one governed range.
distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Timing, electronic targets, and result systems coordinate event state.
distributed_arena_relation.latency_governance: Not a remote synchronous performance issue.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Target, equipment, and event-class controls support comparison.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Officials and electronic scoring operate at the range.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Range command and safety authority are centralized.
distributed_arena_relation.uncertainty: Electronic scoring does not convert the physical range into a remote arena.

agency_segments.boundary_description: The player's inning or turn from address through resulting table state.
agency_segments.causal_attribution: Aiming, stroke, spin, and speed control are causally necessary.
agency_segments.uncertainty: No material phase ambiguity remains at this level of analysis.

distributed_arena_relation.physical_site_relation: Players share one physical table and venue.
distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: The physical table state is directly shared.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Table, ball, cue, and match specifications support comparison.
distributed_arena_relation.uncertainty: Physical spatial reasoning is not a computational distributed-arena relation.

agency_segments.boundary_description: From map start to score submission in the governed match.
agency_segments.allowed_assistance: Tracked controllers, headset, tournament maps, and permitted software.
agency_segments.causal_attribution: Player timing and tracked movement are causally necessary.
agency_segments.uncertainty: No material phase ambiguity remains at this level of analysis.

distributed_arena_relation.physical_site_relation: Competitors may perform from separate physical sites while sharing scheduled maps and match state.
distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Tournament software, map timing, score submission, and communications coordinate the contest.
distributed_arena_relation.latency_governance: Network and stream conditions are governed operationally but public tolerances are incomplete.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Hardware and tracking equivalence remain imperfect.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Software and tournament staff administer results and disputes.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Physical play-space safety remains local to each competitor.
distributed_arena_relation.uncertainty: The examined tournament evidence supports remote competition structure but not full federation-grade cross-site controls.

agency_segments.boundary_description: The venue session during which tracked movement, aiming, and tactics produce score.
agency_segments.allowed_assistance: Venue tracking, wireless equipment, controllers, and safety monitoring.
agency_segments.causal_attribution: Player movement and tactical action are causally necessary.
agency_segments.uncertainty: No material phase ambiguity remains at this level of analysis.

distributed_arena_relation.physical_site_relation: Players share one physical free-roam venue coupled to one computational arena.
distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Venue tracking and game state synchronize all participants.
distributed_arena_relation.latency_governance: Local wireless and tracking latency are operational safety and integrity concerns.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Venue mapping and tracking calibration must align physical and virtual boundaries.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Software and venue operators administer the session.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Venue operator controls collision avoidance, boundaries, and emergency response.
distributed_arena_relation.uncertainty: Cross-venue equivalence remains outside this product-level record.

agency_segments.boundary_description: The patient exercise and feedback cycle defined by the therapeutic protocol.
agency_segments.allowed_assistance: Motion capture, adaptive task parameters, and therapist-selected protocol.
agency_segments.causal_attribution: Patient movement is causally necessary; clinical supervision does not execute the movement.
agency_segments.uncertainty: No material phase ambiguity remains at this level of analysis.

distributed_arena_relation.physical_site_relation: Patient and supervising clinician operate within one treatment environment.
distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Motion capture and therapeutic software synchronize movement and feedback.
distributed_arena_relation.latency_governance: Local sensing latency may affect feedback but no remote contest claim is made.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Clinical setup and patient-specific calibration govern the exercise.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: No sport officiation; clinical supervision governs protocol.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Clinical responsibility and patient suitability are central.
distributed_arena_relation.uncertainty: Remote rehabilitation configurations require separate product and protocol evidence.

participatory_actor_relations.action_window: Before and during the therapeutic exercise.
participatory_actor_relations.mechanism: The clinician selects or adjusts protocol parameters and supervises safe execution.
participatory_actor_relations.resource_or_constraint_effect: The supervisor changes task conditions without performing the patient's movement.
participatory_actor_relations.uncertainty: Clinical roles and software permissions may vary by deployment.
